book.title: Galatians Saint Paul, Galatia Nahkat Gwa'an Gwik'injiighit Nąįį ts'ą' Ch'adąąnt'tł'oo

content: Nakhwaa Googwantrii Dąį' Nihłats'ohnyąą

Shachaa nąįį, nakhwatee ch'ihłee tr'agwaanduu tr'agwah'in ji', nakhwan ch'ihłee juu Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa doo'ya' yuunyąą gwik'it t'inchy'aa nąįį yaa tr'agwah'in, gaa khai'gwidlii vaa tr'agahoh'yaa gwizhrįh, ąįįts'ą' łyaa gwinzii adak'ahoontyaa gwizhrįh, nakhwan chan vaa t'akhwa'yaa kwaa eenjit.
Nakhwaa gwiizųų dąį' nihłats'ohnyąą, jyąhts'ą' t'ee Christ va-law k'eegohthat t'oonchy'aa.
Nakhwatee ch'ihłee hool'ee niindhan ji', hil'ee kwaa ts'ą' zhyaa adats'ą' oots'it t'inchy'aa.

Jii jyaa doonchy'aa t'oonchy'aa, nakhwatee gwagwaanchy'aa haa nats'ąą nakhwagwitr'it gwanlii gwik'iighai' idininjich'ohthat. Nakhwagwitr'it gwinzii ji' adashoo ǫhłįį, ts'ą' ch'izhii nąįį jyaa dii'in dohnyąą haa nihłandaa gwinzii t'ahoh'ya' shrǫ'.
Juu nąįį datthak ideenjit gwizhrįh ch'igiheeghwaa goo'aii geh'an.
Ąįį juu Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik agwaa'ee t'ee zhit juu vats'anh gwigwil'ee ąįį k'eegwiichy'aa gwat'aahchy'aa ji' yits'iheenjyaa t'oonchy'aa.

Ideenjit zhyaa k'ii'an oonts'it shrǫ', Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa veentak gwakwaa t'inchy'aa. Dinjii jidii niłshįį khaihłan niheelyaa goo'aii, Dinjii nats'ąą dinjii inli' ky'aa ch'aroahkat drin ji' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa yuuhahkat t'oonchy'aa.
Tr'agwaanduu gwigwitr'it gwanlii gwizhrįh gwiiłshįį ji', ch'ichį' zhrįh gwiiłshįį gwats'ąnh nooheendal. Ch'anky'aa Shroodiinyąą haa gwiilshįį ji', gwandaii ndaanąą'ąį' kwaa ąįį nooheendal.
Gwinzii gwizhrįh diigwitr'it gwanlii ji', geecheeroondak shrǫ', akhagoiinyąą kwaa ji', nijin gwanzhįh khaihłan niriinlii izhit drin nigweheedhaa.
Ąįįts'ą' khit lęįį nąįį ts'ą' dinjii nizįį iinlii, zhit juu gwik'iinjigwiighit di'įį nąįį ch'andaa ts'ą' tr'iheezyaa.
Khaiinkǫǫ Akǫǫ Digwinyąą ts'ą' Nihłanli' Tr'oonjii
Shanli' haa nakhwats'ą' ch'adįhtł'oo ts'ą' nitsii chan dhałtsąįį!

Zhit juu nakhwadhah gihłeerohoht'ii giindhan nąįį zhyaa gwik'injigiighit adagaa'įį ts'ą' zhit gwa'an t'igwii'in googwąąh'in izhit gwizhrįh geenigiitii t'igii'in. Christ va-cross kat gidiirohtsak shrǫ' giindhan geh'an jyąhts'ą' googwitr'it gwanlii.
Ąįįts'ą' juu vadhah gihłeerihiłt'uu nąįį Law k'eegwahthat kwaa, nakhwadhah gihłeerohoht'ii nakhwagoonyąą, zhyaa nakhwadhah gihłeehoht'ii nakhwagiłtsąįį geech'igehee'yaa geenjit t'igii'in

Shįį ąįį, ideech'ih'in ji', Diik'eegwaadhat Jesus Christ cross kat diineenjit niindhat gwizhrįh geech'i'in t'ihnyąą. Ąįį cross eh'an dzaa nankat dinjii nąįį k'it gwįįhdaii kwaa ts'ą' jaghaii nats'ąą gwįįhdaii gwik'it gwįįhdaii t'ishi'in gaagiindaii kwaa.
Dinjii vadhah gihłeerihiłt'uu akwat vadhah gihłeerihiłt'uu kwaa gaa t'ohłii t'oonchy'aa kwaa t'oonchy'aa. Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa k'iighai' ch'ijuk dinjii neerilii gwizhrįh gwandaa gwinzii.
Juu gwandaii gwizhit datthak jii kwaii gwik'eegwahthat nąįį, tsinehdan akwat neeshraahchy'aa niindhan goovaa oolį' geedan chan ąįįts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vigii nąįį datthak chan!
It'ee jii zhrįh, chan ch'ihłee shaa gwiizųų gohtsyaa shrǫ', Jesus vi-slave ihłii izhit geh'an shakat shat gwanlii.
Shijyaa nąįį, Diik'eegwaadhat Jesus Christ vich'eegoonzhrii datthak nakhwaa oolį'. Amen!
